special_topic: Lunar New Year 農曆新年

g5.en: We can share love! Happy Lunar New Year!
g5.zh: 我們可以分享愛！農曆新年快樂！

g6.en: Firecrackers and lion dances, Spring couplets greet the day. We enjoy food and smile so bright. Happy Lunar New Year!
g6.zh: 鞭炮和舞龍舞獅，春聯迎接新的一天。我們享受美食，笑容燦爛。農曆新年快樂！
